title: Promise grade, version 1
description: The output of rubric 1 of the promise grade: a pure function of one promise card (version 1), computed by clients and never written on chain. It grades how much of a work's permanence is locked, not the work. Rubric: docs/spec/declarations-and-conventions.md (DCL-30, DCL-31).

card.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the card graded.

reasons.description: One line per rubric row that scored, or capped the letter, in rubric order.
